title: Text model routing gets a reshuffle
summary:
Bidara opened to anonymous use, text routes changed models, and the API docs became easier to follow.

Bidara moved from Seed-tier to anonymous access. The `openai` route now uses GPT-4o mini, `openai-large` uses GPT-4.1, and `openai-fast` and `openai-roblox` use GPT-4.1 nano. The `openai-audio` route now has a 1,000-character input limit. Internal image-cache exploration tools were also added.

The community projects listing now includes Argent Script, a text-to-speech tool by withthatway powered by GPT-4o Audio.

The API docs now have clearer endpoint sections, tier and authentication guidance, and expanded examples for multimodal requests, vision, speech-to-text, function calling, and text-to-speech. Kontext image-to-image request examples were also added; its Seed-tier eligibility did not change.

highlights.title: Bidara without a tier
highlights.text: Bidara is now available to anonymous text API requests. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=bidara).

highlights.title: Updated OpenAI model routes
highlights.text: `openai-large` now routes to GPT-4.1, while `openai` uses GPT-4o mini and `openai-fast` and `openai-roblox` use GPT-4.1 nano. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
